priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the target.
Use stat-granting on-use Trinkets right before Bestial Wrath.
Activate Bestial Wrath and aim the resulting Stampede to cover as many targets as possible.
Use all Barbed Shot charges right before Bestial Wrath comes off cooldown.
Maintain 100% uptime on Beast Cleave by casting Multi-Shot every 4 seconds.
Cast Bestial Wrath on cooldown to maximize damage windows.
Cast Kill Command as your primary priority to trigger Vicious Hunt and consume stacks.
Maintain 3 stacks of Frenzy on your pets using Barbed Shot, ideally refreshing with less than 2 seconds remaining.
Cast Explosive Shot on cooldown against 3+ targets.
Cast Kill Shot on targets below 20% health to trigger Cull the Weak.
Cast Dire Beast on cooldown to gain additional haste and pet pressure.
Use Cobra Shot only as a filler when Kill Command is on cooldown and you are at risk of capping Focus.
